sqlMap.select: SELECT A.BUYER, A.DOC_NO, KEY_1 AS APPRID, B.LEGACY_USER_ID, A.SUBJECT, A.CONTENTS, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS ADD_DATE, C.IMAGE_KEY AS IMAGE_KEY FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOMLUSR B , ICOGDOCU C WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'HWDF') AND A.KEY_9 IS NULL AND A.KEY_1 IS NOT NULL AND A.IF_FLAG = 'F' AND B.USER_ID = A.APP_USER_ID AND C.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND C.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_APM_SEND A SET KEY_8 = #RTN_MSG# , IF_FLAG = #RTN_FLAG# , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#
sqlMap.select:
SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, DECODE(A.KEY_2, '2', '9', A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, B.LEGACY_USER_ID, B.USER_NAME_LOC, C.TEXT1 AS APPRDEPTNM FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOMLUSR B , ICOMCOD2 C WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#
AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
AND C.TYPE = 'C001' AND C.COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND C.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY A.APP_SEQ
SELECT DOC_NO, TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ)) AS DOC_SEQ, TYPE, DES_FILE_NAME, SRC_FILE_NAME,DES_FILE_DIR FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = #IMAGE_KEY#
